subtitle: A quiet offline teacher
promotional_text: A pocket teacher for a four-step room walk, a rising-column breath, and a private journal.
description: Orchard Bell is a complete offline teacher. Finish onboarding, follow Walk across four guidance steps, run Four Columns as a rising-column breath, choose a Range, and save a Tablet note. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your window and journal stay on your device.
app_review_notes: Orchard Bell is a fully offline attention-practice and private-journal app. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four guidance steps, start Four Columns breathing, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
